interpretation_ko: 삶의 평온을 해치는 일이 많아지고 사업이 못마땅해질 조짐
interpretation_en: you will find much to mar the calmness of your life, and business will turn a disagreeable front to you

cite.original: If you dream of discussing religion and feel religiously inclined, you will find much to mar the calmness of your life, and business will turn a disagreeable front to you.
cite.translation_ko: 종교를 이야기하며 신앙심이 깊어짐을 느끼는 꿈은, 삶의 평온을 해치는 일이 많아지고 사업이 못마땅해질 조짐이다

interpretation_en: she will disgust her lover with her efforts to act ingenuous innocence and goodness

cite.original: If a young woman imagines that she is over religious, she will disgust her lover with her efforts to act ingenuous innocence and goodness.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 스스로 지나치게 신앙심 깊다고 여기는 꿈은, 순진함과 선함을 꾸미려다 정인에게 정떨어질 조짐이다

context: 처녀가 신앙심이 없으나 잘못을 저지르지 않았다고 여김
interpretation_ko: 당당하고 솔직하며 남을 배려하는 성품으로 뭇사람의 존경과 사랑을 받을 조짐
interpretation_en: it foretells that she will have that independent frankness and kind consideration for others, which wins for women profound respect, and love from the opposite sex as well as her own

cite.original: If she is irreligious and not a transgressor, it foretells that she will have that independent frankness and kind consideration for others, which wins for women profound respect, and love from the opposite sex as well as her own; but if she is a transgressor in the eyes of religion, she will find that there are moral laws, which, if disregarded, will place her outside the pale of honest recognition. She should look well after her conduct.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 신앙심이 없으나 잘못을 저지르지 않았다고 여기는 꿈은, 당당하고 솔직하며 남을 배려하는 성품으로 뭇사람의 존경과 사랑을 받을 조짐이다

interpretation_en: she will be disappointed in the desires of her heart

cite.original: If she weeps over religion, she will be disappointed in the desires of her heart.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 종교 때문에 우는 꿈은, 마음속 바람이 실망으로 끝날 조짐이다

context: 종교 문제로 처녀가 죄는 없으나 반항적임

interpretation_en: she will shoulder burdens bravely, and stand firm against deceitful admonitions

cite.original: If she is defiant, but innocent of offence, she will shoulder burdens bravely, and stand firm against deceitful admonitions.
cite.translation_ko: 종교 문제로 처녀가 죄는 없으나 반항적인 꿈은, 짐을 용감히 짊어지고 거짓된 훈계에 굳세게 맞설 조짐이다

interpretation_en: you will find that you will be almost induced to give up your own personality to please some one whom you hold in reverent esteem

cite.original: If you are self-reproached in the midst of a religious excitement, you will find that you will be almost induced to give up your own personality to please some one whom you hold in reverent esteem.
cite.translation_ko: 신앙의 흥분 속에서 스스로를 자책하는 꿈은, 존경하는 이를 기쁘게 하려 제 개성을 거의 버리게 될 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that your life will be more in harmony with creation than formerly. Your prejudices will not be so aggressive

cite.original: To see religion declining in power, denotes that your life will be more in harmony with creation than formerly. Your prejudices will not be so aggressive.
cite.translation_ko: 종교의 힘이 약해지는 것을 보는 꿈은, 삶이 전보다 자연과 더 조화를 이루고 편견이 누그러질 조짐이다

cite.original: To dream that a minister in a social way tells you that he has given up his work, foretells that you will be the recipient of unexpected tidings of a favorable nature, but if in a professional and warning way, it foretells that you will be overtaken in your deceitful intriguing, or other disappointments will follow.
